notes: Repairing a share now finishes the job: after re-pulling fresh history, the app immediately recomputes this device's signals from it — before, the fresh data sat on disk while every score still judged the old world, which could make a repaired share look like a rule disagreement. The 🔬 check also detects that situation on its own now (it compares a stored score against what the data actually says and tells you when the scores are older than the data). One garbled sentence in the diagnosis is fixed too.
